description text: "The water meters type sonico EDGE are ultrasonic water meters with an electronic indicating device designed to measure, memorise and display the volume at metering conditions of water passing through the measurement transducer. They consist of a cast iron body with connecting screw threads (flanged), one pair of ultrasonic transducers and the electronic indicating device formed by an LCD display showing volume and flow. Displayed volume resolution is 0.0001 m³ and 0.001 m³. Legally non-relevant communication is possible via optical sensor; the meter has software separation with SW versions and CRCs displayed in the auto-rounding menu. Each volume indication (forward and reverse flow) is displayed every two minutes; the permanently shown volume is the difference between reverse and forward delivered volumes. The meters are powered from mains 24 V DC with an internal battery for temporary power failure and can be installed in arbitrary positions. An optional impulse module is not part of this certificate."
